C-PORTAL-PROSE.Summary: Review the complete standalone English portal wording with humanize and selectively adopt improvements in clarity and formal professional style, preserving the charter as the source of truth.

Goals.Goal: Cover all explanatory page sources and shared English page copy, retain per-document proposals and reports, and review their actual differences.
Adopt sound wording improvements while preserving professional terminology, source meaning, bilingual equivalence and the working portal.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: the user explicitly requested a full run over site pages, review of its outcomes and adoption of sensible changes, specifying that the charter is the source of truth and only standalone page wording is to change. This bundle records that authorized sequence.

Charter, Registry and Portfolio sources remain byte-identical to the start baseline. Both vocabularies govern names and interpretation; do not redefine a Role, decision, state, condition, commitment or measure.

Humanize workers generate proposals sequentially. The controller reads every report and difference, records adoption decisions, and applies only reviewed edits. A tool gate pass alone is not editorial acceptance.

Preserve the professional business, finance and IT register, source identity, page routes, numbered clauses, links, diagram topology, table structure, JSON keys and placeholders. Do not adopt unsupported new facts or invented citations.

Terms of Use and Privacy are excluded from this stylistic pass under the humanize exclusions for contract terms and regulated disclosures. Charter-derived content is read-only. Reconcile affected Russian page wording and translation metadata only after confirming equivalent meaning; no language is designated authoritative.
Preserve unrelated working-tree changes. Generated HTML is rebuilt from sources and never manually patched. Installed skills remain unchanged.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Charter or operational-record revisions, a substantive legal or factual audit, new service commitments, modifications to unrelated portals, tool-package changes, commit, push or deployment.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The coverage inventory accounts for all standalone English page sources, shared English copy, reused pilot results and explicit exclusions.
Every proposal has a recorded editorial disposition, and each adopted edit preserves source claims, formal terminology and charter meaning.
Charter, Registry and Portfolio files match their recorded checksums; affected Russian sources and translation comparisons are reconciled.
Source, renderer, scaffolding, generated-site and repeatability checks pass; changed page routes are inspected in the rendered portal.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Humanize run, complete per-document review decisions, selected source differences and rendered-page inspection.
